\mxunit{enrichment-waiting-time-exercises}{Waiting for the first success}
\mxsubtitle{Upper high school · probability and sequences \textperiodcentered{} Progressive exercises \textperiodcentered{} 08}

\begin{exercise}
With $p=\frac{1}{4}$, find $P(T=3)$.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
With $p=\frac{1}{4}$, find $P(T\leq 3)$.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
For $0<p<1$, find $P(T>m+n|T>m)$.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Success has probability $0.2$ at each independent trial. What is the mean waiting time? Must the fifth trial succeed?
\end{exercise}
